question: JDF 611's 'File the Request' step names four filings. Two of them -- a notice and a second order -- were carried as unresolved because an earlier reading of the guide could not recover their digits. This record resolves both, and records how, so the answer is checkable rather than asserted.

textLayerFinding.consequence: The digits are present in the document's text layer, so the earlier extraction failure was a property of the extractor used, not of the document. Identification here still rests on the page image, as the lane requires; the text layer is recorded only as a second, independent reading that agrees with it.
